=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2678-2686,2789-2798 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After the blocked-merge guard defers the direct merge, the deferral branches of both the `merge` and `terminal` chains always set `RB_MERGE_STATUS="mergeability_pending"`, even when `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` returned 1 because of a non-transient `--auto` refusal (line 2505), for example "Auto merge is not allowed for this repository", DRAFT_MESSAGE, or HTTP 403/405/422.
  WHY: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5881-5883` maps `mergeability_pending` to `JUDGE_ALERT_LEVEL="DEBUG"` ("Stall recovery will retry automatically"), so a permanent refusal loops on every stall-recovery pass with no page and the PR never merges; before this PR the direct merge landed it. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. `test_non_transient_auto_error_after_a_site_deferral_is_not_retried` in tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py pins the wrong status.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2527-2538 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In auto-only mode, the retry helper can exit through `outcome=head_moved` (2527-2530) or `outcome=not_open` (2535-2538). The deferral branch at 2678-2686 / 2790-2798 then reports `mergeability_pending` with the message "merge deferred and auto-merge not enabled; GitHub reports mergeable_state=blocked". Without a deferral, the same outcomes end as `merge_failed`.
  WHY: A closed PR, or a head moved off the judged SHA, is reported at DEBUG (review_autofix.yml:5881) as a blocked-mergeability wait, so the reason operators see is misleading. Impact is limited because stall recovery re-fires the judge either way. All three reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "§15: one REST POST per CI run for the status; the guard reuses the PR JSON each path already holds."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, the merge_with_followup `rb_judge_sync_merge_guard` call at line 3356 (minimax_minimax-m3 also names the call sites at line 2673 (`merge`) and line 2785 (`terminal`))
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The evidence below is combined from all four reviewers. `_pr_json` is fetched and kept by the polling loop at lines 3200-3232 (merge_with_followup) and at lines 2598-2619 (merge/terminal). The guard call at line 3356 (and at 2673/2785, per minimax) passes no JSON, so the wrapper (2451-2471) falls back to `${1:-${PR_NUMBER}}` at line 2467. `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard` (pr_checks_lib.sh:783-787; lines 750-770 in the diff) then issues another `gh_retry` GET `repos/<repo>/pulls/<n>`. No diff hunk passes the held JSON at this site, and this is the only guarded path that does not reuse its JSON (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:35562 and 15730). All four reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes this gap: `_pr_json` is fetched at line 3201, before the check-runs wait and the base-freshness gate, so its `mergeable_state` can be stale, and a fresh GET by PR number is the safer choice at 1 call per merge attempt.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2678-2686 (`merge` chain deferral branch; same branch in the `terminal` chain; line 2505 non-transient `--auto` return 1) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: After a guard deferral, `--auto` is the only merge path left. When GitHub refuses it for a reason that will not go away (e.g. "Auto merge is not allowed for this repository"), the branch still sets `RB_MERGE_STATUS="mergeability_pending"`.
  WHY: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` lines 5881-5883 map the status to DEBUG ("Stall recovery will retry automatically"), and `scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:75` treats it as re-dispatchable, so the PR loops with no page and never merges. Fix: set `merge_failed` when `RB_MERGE_ERR_AUTO_FILE` is non-empty and not transient, and update `test_non_transient_auto_error_after_a_site_deferral_is_not_retried` in tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2527-2530, 2535-2538 (reached via auto-only mode at 2498-2501; deferral branch 2678-2686) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Auto-only mode can now stop on head_moved or not_open, and the caller still reports "merge deferred and auto-merge not enabled; GitHub reports mergeable_state=blocked" with `mergeability_pending`. Without a deferral, the same outcomes end as `merge_failed`.
  WHY: A closed PR or a moved head is reported as a blocked-mergeability wait at DEBUG (review_autofix.yml 5881), so the reason is wrong. Impact is limited because stall recovery re-fires either way.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. The reviewer rejects the pass-1 TASK_GAP about `_pr_json` at scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3356 because the JSON from line 3201 can be stale, so the fresh GET is safer. The reviewer also notes that the unguarded direct merges in workflow-log-analysis.yml and update_workflows.yml were deferred to a follow-up issue, and that owner steps O1-O3 are ruleset actions outside the code.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh deferral branches of `merge`/`terminal` (around 2681-2683): `rb_judge_merge_err_report` mixes the stale transient `direct:` stderr with the `--auto` refusal. Fix: `[ -n "${RB_MERGE_ERR_DIR:-}" ] && : > "${RB_MERGE_ERR_DIRECT_FILE}"`. ~2 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2678-2686, 2790-2798 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After a site guard deferral, `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient auto <path>` can return 1 for distinct reasons: non-transient `--auto` stderr (DRAFT_MESSAGE, branch-protection refusal, 422), head_moved (2527-2530), not_open (2535-2538), or exhausted transient retries. The deferral elif sets `mergeability_pending` unconditionally for all of them.
  WHY: `review_autofix.yml:5881-5883` maps the status to DEBUG, so the judge loops indefinitely with no page. `tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py:840-848` pins `mergeability_pending` for DRAFT_MESSAGE. Fix: the helper exposes its outcome (e.g. `RB_RETRY_OUTCOME`) so the elif can choose `merge_failed` or `mergeability_pending`.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2527-2530, 2535-2538 (via deferral elif 2678-2686 / 2790-2798) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The deferral elif conflates a closed-PR or moved-head exit with a mergeability wait: `mergeability_pending` with a deferral, `merge_failed` without one.
  WHY: The alert is suppressed at DEBUG with a misleading reason. `scripts/review_review_blocked_post_comment.sh:75` re-dispatches the judge, but the misleading status stays in logs.

  Evidence of absence: The loops at lines 2598-2619 and 3200-3232 fetch `_pr_json`, but all call sites invoke the guard with no argument (fallback `${1:-${PR_NUMBER}}` at line 2467). `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard` then issues a fresh `gh_retry` GET (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` lines 750-770 in the diff). The 3356 site is the most clear-cut.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
